aboutGame.title: What is Star Trek Outposts Unknown?
paragraphs: Star Trek Outposts Unknown is a narrative-driven outpost builder from Magic Fuel Games and Playstack. Set in the 23rd century during the Strange New Worlds era, it follows the crew of the U.S.S. Resonant as they build research outposts across the X'Lehari System and aid a fragile civilization facing a cosmic threat.

The game combines real-time-with-pause colony management with exploration, branching research, production chains, and officer development. Players balance power, housing, food, medical supplies, metal, and transport while six crew roles keep every outpost running.

explore.title: Explore Star Trek Outposts Unknown Wiki
explore.description: Use these eight guides to plan your first landing, stabilize supply chains, assign crew, choose research, and follow the Tetryon Rift mystery across the X'Lehari System.

modules.name: Star Trek Outposts Unknown Beginner Guide
modules.description: Build a stable first outpost with a clear opening checklist covering mission briefings, scans, research, crew assignments, and supply reserves.

highlights.detail: Read the mission briefing and note the current objective before placing any structure.
Scan the landing zone and compare environmental conditions, resource access, and room to expand.
Place one modest outpost and confirm its power, housing, and supply chain before adding a second site.
Assign crew by strength and keep morale and prowess in view before dangerous encounters.
Test one vehicle route and one transporter transfer so you understand the real cost of each.
Keep the research queue full and make a manual save before every major build.

modules.name: Star Trek Outposts Unknown Resource Management
modules.description: Keep research, construction, exploration, crew morale, and storage moving together instead of letting one bottleneck stall the whole colony.

highlights.label: Research
highlights.detail: Keep one research thread staffed; idle research time is the largest early progression loss.

highlights.label: Power
highlights.detail: Solve power and utility capacity before placing advanced production or research modules.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: Add buffer capacity with each production line so overflow never becomes wasted output.

highlights.label: Transport
highlights.detail: Use vehicles for surface hauling and transporters for precise transfers between outposts.

highlights.label: Morale
highlights.detail: Rotate high-stress assignments and check morale after every dangerous encounter.

highlights.label: Crew
highlights.detail: Leave one flexible assignment open so a story event does not dismantle your economy.

modules.name: Star Trek Outposts Unknown Crew Guide
modules.description: Compare the six Starfleet crew roles and understand how assignments, morale, prowess, and officer development shape outpost output and encounter survival.

highlights.label: Command
highlights.detail: Leads mission priorities and keeps exploration, research, and construction aligned.

highlights.label: Engineering
highlights.detail: Supports construction, repairs, power systems, and the production chain.

highlights.label: Medical
highlights.detail: Maintains crew health and medical processing after injuries and hazardous field work.

highlights.label: Navigation
highlights.detail: Handles route planning, planetary surveys, and movement across the X'Lehari System.

highlights.label: Science
highlights.detail: Staffs research facilities and turns survey data into new technology.

highlights.label: Security
highlights.detail: Protects away teams and outposts during dangerous encounters.

modules.name: Star Trek Outposts Unknown Buildings and Research
modules.description: Plan the outpost footprint around power, housing, research, storage, production, and repairs so each module can support the next tech tier.

highlights.label: Power
highlights.detail: Place utilities first; every research, production, and habitat module depends on a stable supply.

highlights.label: Housing
highlights.detail: Expand crew capacity early so morale and staffing do not stall as the outpost grows.

highlights.label: Research
highlights.detail: Staff research facilities continuously to unlock new structures and technology tiers.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: Buffer every production line and leave space for resources that arrive from other worlds.

highlights.label: Production
highlights.detail: Build the full input-to-output chain instead of placing isolated harvesters or refiners.

highlights.label: Repairs
highlights.detail: Keep maintenance crews available; damaged buildings remove throughput from the colony.

modules.name: Star Trek Outposts Unknown Planets Guide
modules.description: Rank the X'Lehari System's known destinations by first-outpost risk, resource access, and the logistics support each world demands.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Daegus — tropical oasis with water, organics, and open building space; the safest place to learn the core outpost loop.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Kourou — frozen glaciers, volcanic badlands, and steam fields; strong resources behind a demanding three-biome logistics puzzle.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Neral — the most hostile known world; bring developed officers, deep reserves, and a mature supply network.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Tetryon Rift sites — story-critical destinations that should wait until Daegus and Kourou outposts can run without constant rescue.

modules.name: Star Trek Outposts Unknown Gameplay Tips
modules.description: Use pause deliberately, protect crew morale, and keep flexible buffers so the outpost survives while the Resonant travels to a new world.

highlights.label: Pause
highlights.detail: Freeze the clock before major placements, tech unlocks, and dangerous story encounters.

highlights.label: Morale
highlights.detail: Rotate demanding jobs and treat crew stress as a resource that needs active management.

highlights.label: Buffers
highlights.detail: Stock enough food, medicine, and spare materials to survive one interrupted delivery.

highlights.label: Cadre
highlights.detail: Concentrate officer development on a small command group instead of spreading it across the roster.

highlights.label: Routes
highlights.detail: Build compact outposts and shorten supply lines before expanding deeper into the system.

highlights.label: Scans
highlights.detail: Survey a planet before committing structures; environment and resource access drive the layout.

modules.name: Star Trek Outposts Unknown System Requirements
modules.description: Check the official PC minimum and recommended specifications before installing Star Trek Outposts Unknown and planning a long colony run.

highlights.label: RAM
highlights.detail: 16 GB is required at both minimum and recommended tiers; 8 GB systems are below spec.

highlights.label: GPU
highlights.detail: GTX 1660 6 GB or RX 5600 XT 8 GB at minimum; RTX 3060 or RX 5700 XT recommended.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: 10 GB available space, with extra room left for saves, patches, and shader caches.

highlights.label: OS
highlights.detail: Windows 10 version 21H1 or a current 64-bit Windows installation.

highlights.label: CPU
highlights.detail: Ryzen 5 2600 or Core i5-8500 at minimum; Ryzen 7 7800X3D or Core i5-14600K recommended.

modules.name: Star Trek Outposts Unknown Story and Missions
modules.description: Follow the U.S.S. Resonant's mission through the X'Lehari System, from first contact and outpost construction to the Tetryon Rift mystery.

highlights.label: Resonant
highlights.detail: The outpost builder-ship serves as command base, orbital warehouse, and supply line for every landing.

highlights.label: Tetryon
highlights.detail: The rift is the central mystery, and each destination adds another angle on the threat.

highlights.label: April
highlights.detail: Admiral Robert April appears in the 23rd-century story alongside other familiar Starfleet faces.

highlights.label: Aid
highlights.detail: The mission is to help a fragile civilization facing an impending catastrophe while the cosmic threat grows.

highlights.label: Outposts
highlights.detail: Permanent research outposts form the campaign's network, so each settlement must run without the captain present.

items.question: What is Star Trek Outposts Unknown?
items.answer: Star Trek Outposts Unknown is a narrative-driven outpost builder from Magic Fuel Games and Playstack, set in the 23rd-century X'Lehari System. Players build research outposts, manage six crew roles, and balance exploration, technology, and logistics while investigating the Tetryon Rift.

items.question: Is Star Trek Outposts Unknown a combat game?
items.answer: No. Star Trek Outposts Unknown is a single-player colony sim with real-time-with-pause strategy elements. Dangerous encounters test crew morale and prowess, but the core loop is research, exploration, construction, and resource management.

items.question: What should I build first in Star Trek Outposts Unknown?
items.answer: Begin with one modest outpost on a scanned world. Stabilize power and housing, staff research facilities, connect the first production chain, and add storage before expanding to a second site.

items.question: How do crew roles work in Star Trek Outposts Unknown?
items.answer: Star Trek Outposts Unknown uses six roles: Command, Engineering, Medical, Navigation, Science, and Security. Assign officers by strength, rotate high-stress work, and concentrate development on a small core group.

items.question: Which planet should I explore first in Star Trek Outposts Unknown?
items.answer: Start on Daegus, the tropical world used for the playable demo. Move to Kourou after your first outpost is stable, and treat Neral as a late challenge because it is the most hostile known world in the system.
